entry.summary:
"If you are ready to fully understand yourself and your practice, it is by far the best thing you can do."

Hear what our students have to say about the Master of Creative Practice. 

Applications for July still open — enrol now to start mastering your craft!

Ready to take your creative practice further? Please visit https://www.unitec.ac.nz/career-and-study-options/creative-industries/master-of-creative-practice/
